recorded: Hand-authored. No live model produced this run; it is the record of what /iterate-visual must do when the first render already reads.

items.note: No gridlines, no tick marks, no border; the value axis is off because every value is written on its bar.
Two bars, one comparison: checklist against control.
The title is the Claim sentence with both shares in it, not an axis label.
A layered text mark writes 34.8% and 28.5% beside their bars; no legend and no axis to trace.
The control bar is grey; only the checklist bar carries the accent the Claim is about.
Accent and grey differ in lightness as well as hue; the bars stay distinct rendered without colour.
The value scale runs 0 to 0.5, so each bar's length is its share.

outcome.note: Every rubric item passed on the first look, so the loop stopped. Three passes is a maximum, never a quota.
